program:
(rule!
 ;; A rectangular frame of four colored lines holds scattered dots
 ;; whose color matches ONE side. Crop to the frame; inside, every
 ;; occupied scan line smears solid toward the matching wall: dots
 ;; colored like the top wall fill from the wall down to their last
 ;; dot, like the bottom wall from their first dot to the wall, and
 ;; the left/right walls likewise along rows.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (line? vals total)
       (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals))
              (m (mode-list colors)))
         (and (>= (length colors) (- total 2))
              (not (eq? m #f))
              (>= (count-if (lambda (v) (= v m)) colors) (- total 2)))))
     (define line-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (line? (row g r) w)) (range 0 h)))
     (define line-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (line? (col g c) h)) (range 0 w)))
     (define top-r (first line-rows))
     (define bot-r (second line-rows))
     (define left-c (first line-cols))
     (define right-c (second line-cols))
     (define (line-mode vals)
       (mode-list (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) vals)))
     (define scatter-color
       (mode-list (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                       (filter (lambda (p)
                                 (and (> (first p) top-r)
                                      (< (first p) bot-r)
                                      (> (second p) left-c)
                                      (< (second p) right-c)
                                      (> (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                               (grid-positions g)))))
     (define dir  ;; matched wall, checked in the original priority
       (cond ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g top-r))) 'top)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (row g bot-r))) 'bot)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g left-c))) 'left)
             ((= scatter-color (line-mode (col g right-c))) 'right)
             (else #f)))
     (define vert? (member? dir (list 'top 'bot)))
     (define from-wall? (member? dir (list 'top 'left)))
     (build-grid (+ 1 (- bot-r top-r)) (+ 1 (- right-c left-c)) (orr oc)
                 (cond ((zero? orr) (at g top-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((= orr (- bot-r top-r)) (at g bot-r (+ left-c oc)))
                       ((zero? oc) (at g (+ top-r orr) left-c))
                       ((= oc (- right-c left-c))
                        (at g (+ top-r orr) right-c))
                       ((not dir) 0)
                       (else
                        (let* ((ir (+ top-r orr))
                               (ic (+ left-c oc))
                               (occ (if vert?
                                        (filter (lambda (r)
                                                  (> (at g r ic) 0))
                                                (range (+ top-r 1) bot-r))
                                        (filter (lambda (c)
                                                  (> (at g ir c) 0))
                                                (range (+ left-c 1)
                                                       right-c))))
                               (pos (if vert? ir ic)))
                          (if (and (not (null? occ))
                                   (if from-wall?
                                       (<= pos (max-list occ))
                                       (>= pos (min-list occ))))
                              scatter-color
                              0))))))))
